Job Description: Job Description – Analyst – IT Risk and Compliance Key Responsibilities Assists with planning and execution of information technology SOX assessments by understanding organizational objectives, processes, policies, internal controls, and applicable regulatory requirements. Assists in identifying control deficiencies and supporting root-cause analysis and remediation activities. Tracks and follows up on IT audit and compliance findings to ensure remediation activities are completed within agreed timelines. Supports external and internal auditors by coordinating documentation, evidence, walkthroughs, and other information requests. Communicates testing progress, observations, and identified issues to the Internal Audit Team and relevant stakeholders. Obtains, analyzes, and evaluates technical and business documentation, reports, system-generated data, process flows, and supporting evidence. Maintains confidentiality of organizational and compliance-related information. Continues to develop knowledge of IT controls, SOX requirements, cybersecurity, business processes, emerging technologies, and industry practices. Qualifications: Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity , or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 3 to 7 years of relevant experience in IT audit, Risk Management, SOX Compliance, ITGCs, technology risk, internal controls, or related fields. Previous experience with a Big 4 or similar audit/consulting environment is preferred but not mandatory . Working knowledge of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements and IT control concepts. Good understanding of IT General Controls , including: Logical access Change management Computer operations System development/change lifecycle Hands-on experience with SAP ITGC/SOX testing is strongly preferred. Working knowledge of SAP GRC and SAP Security , including access provisioning, User Access Reviews (UAR), Segregation of Duties (SoD), Firefighter/Emergency Access, and privileged access controls. Understanding of SAP change management and transport controls , including approvals, testing, production changes, and segregation of duties. Basic to intermediate understanding of IT Automated Controls, application controls, and interfaces . Ability to understand business and IT environments through walkthroughs with application owners, control owners, and other stakeholders. Ability to identify key risks and understand controls designed to mitigate those risks. Experience performing control testing, reviewing supporting evidence, documenting test procedures, and identifying exceptions. Familiarity with business processes such as Finance, IT, HR, Payroll, Inventory, Revenue, and Financial Reporting is preferred. Exposure to enterprise applications such as ServiceNow, Oracle, Salesforce , or similar platforms is an advantage. Professional certifications such as CISA, CPA, CISSP, CRISC , or similar certifications are preferred or may be pursued as part of professional development. Skills and Competencies Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to execute assigned compliance activities independently while seeking guidance for complex or judgmental matters. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with IT, business teams, control owners, and auditors. Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established timelines. Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills. Proactive and willing to learn new technologies, business processes, and compliance requirements. Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio . Experience analyzing data using Excel or other analytics tools is an advantage. Ability to work independently on assigned activities and collaboratively as part of the broader IT Compliance team.

Investment opportunity identification and evaluation. Portfolio monitoring and reporting efficiency. Client retention and relationship development.
